title: Netflix TV v1.4.4
changelog: Added Virtual TV Cursor & Native Touch Engine enabling Android TV remotes to interact with embedded server player buttons (FrameX Backup player, server dropdowns, video controls)
Added 'Server Remote' mode toggle to bottom player controls with high-visibility cursor and guidance HUD
Enabled D-pad spatial velocity acceleration and boundary-clamped cursor targeting
Synthesized OS-level MotionEvent touch down/up events penetrating cross-origin iframe sandboxes
Eliminated CTV video ads on Android TV by standardizing Desktop Chrome User-Agent across devices
Fixed Next.js SSR hydration exception on AutoEmbed server
